name: Brauhaus
kurzbeschreibung:
**Traditional Tyrolean Beer Hall in Rattenberg**

Step into the heart of **Rattenberg**, where the scent of freshly brewed beer and hearty Tyrolean flavors fills the air. Our historic **Brauhaus** invites you to experience authentic **Tirol** hospitality in a rustic yet cozy setting.

Savor classic dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and slow-cooked **Schweinsbraten**, all paired with our house-brewed **Rattenberger Bier**. Whether you're craving a hearty meal or just a cold pint, our warm atmosphere and friendly service make every visit unforgettable.

Come taste the true spirit of **Tirol**—one sip and one bite at a time. **Prost!**
